textbookBox.concept: Demand is the quantity of a good that buyers are willing and able to buy at a price. When price rises, demand usually falls.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 9 social-science · The Price Puzzle: What Drives the Market · Complete Summary
textbookBox.concept: If price is above equilibrium there is a surplus, and sellers cut the price. If it is below, there is a shortage and the price rises.
